title: Move of core systems to AWS
background: CUSTOMER_001 runs freight tracking and invoicing for about 300 business customers from two on-premises server rooms. The hardware leases end on 2027-03-31, so the systems need a new home before then.
objectives: Move the web, application, database and batch systems and the file service to AWS before the hardware leases end.
Provide a highly available production setup that meets the agreed recovery targets.
Provide a separate test environment that runs only during working hours.
Leave the CUSTOMER_001 team trained and supported during the first weeks after go-live.
scope_in: Design, build and test of the production and test environments on AWS.
Migration of the existing systems without application changes.
Recovery setup for production: at most 15 minutes of data loss and restoration within 4 hours.
One half-day training session for the system administrators.
Four weeks of support after go-live.
scope_out: Migration of Active Directory, which stays on-premises.
A recovery setup for the test environment.
Ongoing operation of the environment after the support period.

deliverables.name: Target design
deliverables.description: Design document for the AWS environments, delivered after this SOW is agreed.

deliverables.name: Migration of systems and data
deliverables.description: Completed according to a cut-over plan agreed with the customer.

deliverables.name: Training and support
deliverables.description: One half-day session and four weeks of support.

phases.name: Discovery and design
phases.description: Answer the open items and agree the target design.

phases.name: Build and test
phases.description: Build the environments and test the recovery setup.

phases.name: Migration and go-live
phases.description: Move the systems outside the change-freeze period.

assumptions: No production changes are made between 2026-11-20 and 2027-01-05.
The test environment runs during working hours only.
Data is stored in Frankfurt until the question about data location is answered.
Existing software licences can be used on AWS. The customer confirms this.
customer_responsibilities: Provide access to systems, documentation and people during discovery.
Decide the open items in this document within agreed times.
Confirm the change-freeze period and the go-live date.
Provide a contact for licence questions.
price_summary: The customer expects the monthly AWS cost to stay under USD 9,000 for production and test together (approximate). A price for the work will be confirmed after the open items are answered.

open_questions.question: Must any customer data stay in Israel?
What is the go-live date, given the board's wish for 2026-12-15 and the change freeze from 2026-11-20?
open_questions.assumed_meanwhile: No date is stated in this SOW

open_questions.question: Is extra capacity needed for the peak season (November to January)?
Which option do you prefer for the file service?
open_questions.assumed_meanwhile: A managed file service is proposed

open_questions.question: Can the existing Windows licences be used on AWS?
Can old archive data be removed or archived before the move?
